pages.text: The Rite of Broken Earth is a small ritual working for tearing open the ground beyond the circle. It is a rough, practical piece of witchcraft: less subtle than a ward, less elegant than a grove-raising rite, but excellent when a witch needs a trench, a hazard, or a sudden gap where moments before there was only solid ground.

Offer a $(item)Brew of Erosion$() on a small ritual circle. The first matched offering fixes one of eight headings. The working waits for the next 20-tick boundary, then begins at the sixth point of a 60-position wandering path below the circle and parts one point every tick.

pages.title: Practical Use
pages.text: The cut reaches 8 to 12 blocks deep. More than two nearby Coven Witches widen it, with a small chance of one further block of width. Break or re-click the sustaining circle to stop the working and recover the consumed offering.
